data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 5.7m (2021: GBP 120.9m) is a favourable development of GBP 20.5m (2021: deterioration of GBP 0.8m pre LPT) to claims reserves established at the prior year end.

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss Portfolio Transfer (RiverStone) covering Syndicates 4444 (2020 & prior years) and 1861 (2020 year of account)
prior_year_events.impact_description: LPT concluded in December 2021 - the results for the prior year include the premium ceded to Riverstone of GBP 14m and reinsurers' share of the change in provisions includes the recoveries due on the business reinsured under the agreement.

prior_year_events.event_name: Part VII transfer of EEA policies to Lloyd's Brussels
prior_year_events.impact_description: On 30 December 2020 EEA policies and related liabilities were transferred to Lloyd's Brussels and reinsured back by 100% quota share; combined effect had no economic impact but affected reporting and the reinsurance inwards class.

prior_year_events.event_name: External Reinsurance to Close (2018 & Prior) adjustment
prior_year_events.impact_description: At 31 December 2020 the 2018 & Prior years of account closed by way of an external reinsurance to close agreement; this produced a RITC adjustment in opening positions.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1861's gross claims reserves opened the year at GBP 391.956m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle for prior underwriting years (<=2020) shows a net adverse re-estimation of c. GBP 7.16m (1.8% of opening gross reserves), driven by deterioration in the 2020 underwriting year offset by favourable development in 2019. The Syndicate also reported a material net favourable movement on a net-of-reinsurance basis (GBP 20.5m favourable), reflecting reinsurance recoveries and the impact of a Loss Portfolio Transfer concluded in December 2021; prior-year RITC and Part VII transactions during 2020/2021 materially affected opening positions and reporting. Overall the prior-year movement is a modest gross strengthening, though net movements (after reinsurance) were favourable.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 5.7m (2021: GBP 120.9m) is a favourable development of GBP 20.5m (2021: deterioration of GBP 0.8m pre LPT) to claims reserves established at the prior year end.
The positive claims development during the year has resulted in a combined ratio for the run off Syndicate of 45.2% for 2022, compared to 98.6% in the prior year.

The results for the prior year include the premium ceded to Riverstone of GBP 14m under the contract, while the reinsurers share of the change in provisions for claims includes the recoveries due on the business reinsured under the agreement.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year gross movement was calculated from the gross claims development table (triangle) by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2019 and 2020 (triangle values are presented in GBP 000). The report also quotes a net (after reinsurance) favourable prior-year development of GBP 20.5m; gross and net figures differ due to reinsurance (including a December 2021 LPT) and large RITC adjustments in 2020/2021 (see RITC adjustment of -GBP 327.542m). RITC and Part VII transactions materially distort comparisons; triangle-derived gross PYD should be interpreted with that context.
